svg.title: Caexfer preserves native BDF bytes and projects six format subsets
svg.desc: The top row compares a BDF source and its byte-identical copy. The lower cards show BDF and INP geometry decks; VTU and MSH meshes with numeric fields; FRD mesh with nodal fields; and an OP2 displacement table without embedded geometry. Mesh-bearing representations share the same topology.
svg.text: Native BDF copies preserve the document. Conversions project supported geometry and results.
Mesh-bearing outputs retain cell topology; carried fields depend on the input.
Routes and conditions are specified in the matrix below.
T1 T2 T3 R1 R2 R3
Schematic only: field availability depends on the source; OP2 needs pyNastran and a matching BDF for reading.
